structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", the one the page marks "הזול". The page says that leaves about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, but that's for its example of 10,000 ₪ up front plus 500 ₪ a month at 7%, not my own 30,000.

stuck.why: Set to 10,000 today / 500 a month, not my 30,000; I didn't change them, so the end figure isn't really mine

stuck.where: Steps chart 'מנקודת ההתחלה ועד הכי הרבה' (screen 8)
stuck.why: Says 'עכשיו 79,176 ₪' and the next block says ירושלים MTF, while the page's choice was פסגות; didn't get why
פסגות appears twice with different account costs (-5,416 ₪ and +41 ₪); made me doubt the account really costs 0
Too many similar rows with colourful tags; got bored and just took the top one

stuck.where: Currency section 'עם נטרול מט"ח או בלי' (screens 6-7)
stuck.why: Don't understand it, charts full of minuses; nearly closed the page here

Selected fund row ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) 5139282, marked 'הבחירה'

The rest of the account list (טריידים with big minuses)

findings.what: The example uses 10,000 ₪ up front, not my amount, so the 86,492 ₪ result isn't really mine
Steps chart starts at 'עכשיו 79,176 ₪' with ירושלים MTF even though the page's pick was פסגות; confusing
פסגות shows up twice with different account costs (-5,416 / +41), so I doubted the 0 ₪
Long lists of near-identical funds with many colourful tags I don't understand; got bored
Lots of jargon in the tags: צוברת, נטרול מט"ח, חשיפה לדולר, 4D/4A
Currency section full of minus signs and charts; nearly made me close the page
A wide range 'בין 2,212+ ₪ ל-23,766- ₪' scared me off that fund
No 'what to do first' step or button
